items.description: SessionStart hook for startup|clear|compact
items.name: session-start

items.description: At the start of every session, before your first response, read the using-superpowers skill and follow it.
items.name: session-bootstrap

items.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.
items.name: brainstorming

items.description: Use when a superpowers session went wrong and your human partner wants to know why — repeated work, ignored plans, stumbles, poor results, a skill that didn't fire, "it took too long", "why is it so expensive", "what is it doing" — or wants to build a bug report for the superpowers maintainers, for the current session or a past one identified by id or path, on any harness.
items.name: diagnosing-superpowers

items.description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
items.name: dispatching-parallel-agents

items.description: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available
items.name: executing-plans

items.description: Use when implementation is complete, all tests pass, and you need to decide how to integrate the work
items.name: finishing-a-development-branch

items.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation
items.name: receiving-code-review

items.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
items.name: requesting-code-review

items.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session
items.name: subagent-driven-development

items.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
items.name: systematic-debugging

items.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code
items.name: test-driven-development

items.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback
items.name: using-git-worktrees

items.description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions
items.name: using-superpowers

items.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
items.name: verification-before-completion

items.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
items.name: writing-plans

items.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment
items.name: writing-skills
